title: Ekigezo ky'Ekitonde Ekitukuvu
intro: Ekipande kyasindikibwa eri eggwanga eryali libuze. Wakati mu bulamu bwabwe obw’obutebenkevu wajjawo okulabula —nga kuwerekerwako ekitonde ekyewuunyisa ekyandifuuse ekigezo ekisembayo mu kukkiriza kwabwe. Okuddamu kwabwe kwandisibye enkomerero yaabwe emirembe gyonna. Osobola okuzuula ani yatuusa okulabula kuno era kiki ekyatuuka ku abo abaagaana?
clues: Twali bantu abaali baluŋŋamizibwa ababaka abaali batusooka.
Ekitonde eky’ekitalo kyava ku lusozi, akabonero okuva eri Mukama waffe eri eggwanga lino.
Nabagamba nti: ‘Eno engamiya enkazi eya Allah, kale muleke alye ku nsi ya Allah era temugikwatako na bulabe.’
Naye abantu ne basala eŋŋamira yange enkazi, nga bajeemera ekiragiro kya Mukama waabwe.
Ndi mubaka yekka okuva ewa Mukama wo, eyatumibwa n’amazima — ndi nnabbi era omuweereza eyeesigika.
Ate ab’ebibi, Mukama waffe yabakuba eddoboozi ery’okubwatuka, ne bafuuka abatatambula mu maka gaabwe.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen. (54:31)
